title: Design System: DMSA Pest Control Services

body.purpose: Running text, limited to about 70 characters per line.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main forward action, such as requesting a quotation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--primary, #7b1113); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 180ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7b1113; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; background: #fff; color: #273239; border: 1px solid #c5cdc6; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7b1113; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Grouped content, outlined rather than edged in colour.
components.html:
Prefer to talk?

Call or message DMSA directly.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 24px; background: #fff; color: #273239; border: 1px solid #dce1dc; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #596660; }

narrative.overview: The site behaves like a good technician on a first visit: calm, plain and led by what the property shows. Real job photographs carry the proof, numbered steps explain what happens next, and quotation and phone actions stay close at hand.
keyCharacteristics: Real DMSA photography, never stock imagery or illustration standing in for work.
One brand colour, used for actions, labels and icons.
Plain language grounded in confirmed service details.
Light mode by default, with a full dark theme.

rules.name: The Two Reds Rule
rules.body: --primary is for fills and --primary-text is for text and icons. Any section that overrides one must override the other.

rules.name: The Photo Exception
rules.body: White text and translucent white or black values on photographs and on the wine-red band stay hard-coded, because they don't change with the theme.

rules.name: The Search Words Rule
rules.body: Headings name the service and place in customers' own words, including "anay", rather than a slogan.

dos: Do use real, approved DMSA photos and generalized locations.
Do use --primary-text for any red text or icon.
Do keep colour changes and loading spinners working when reduced motion is on, and drop movement instead.
Do give tap targets at least 24px, and 44px on touch devices where space allows.
donts: Don't add a small label above a heading.
Don't add thick coloured edges to cards or callouts. Use a tint or a one-pixel divider.
Don't nest a card inside a card.
Don't introduce colours outside the wine-red, charcoal, white and neutral-gray palette.
Don't publish exact customer addresses, or unverified ratings, guarantees, certifications or prices.
